mapping(bytes32 => bool) recording already-processed external IDs to prevent double wrapping.

edges.reason: initialize() delegates all bootstrap logic to __initialize().
initialize(address) delegates all bootstrap logic to __initialize(wrapper).
msg.sender is forwarded from the public initialize() into the bootstrap path.
msg.sender becomes the recipient of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE in __initialize.
Privileged roles are assigned to the unauthenticated msg.sender through _setupRole.
wrapper argument flows into __initialize and is granted WRAPPER_ROLE.
__initialize executes the _setupRole privilege grants.
WRAPPER_ROLE onlyRole modifier gates execution of wrap().
wrap() performs the token mint operation.
wrap() writes _extIDs[extID] = true before minting.
wrap() reaches the _mint override that enforces the cap.
The 'to' parameter determines who receives the minted balance.
The caller-supplied amount is added to totalSupply and compared against the cap before minting.
extID is used as the mapping key written in _extIDs.
extID is looked up through wrapped(extID) for the duplicate check.
unwrap() performs the token burn operation.
unwrap() calls _isPCIAddress to validate the destination string.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is burned in unwrap().
extTo is the string validated by _isPCIAddress.
amount parameter controls how many tokens are burned from the caller.
addr is converted to bytes and stored in the addrBytes local.
addrBytes drives the length and byte-prefix checks returning the validation result.
PAUSER_ROLE onlyRole modifier gates pause().
PAUSER_ROLE onlyRole modifier gates unpause().
UPGRADER_ROLE onlyRole modifier gates the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
Successful upgrade authorization leads to the delegatecall-based implementation swap.
newImplementation becomes the delegatecall target of the upgrade routine.
The delegatecall payload runs in proxy context and can re-enter state-changing entry points such as wrap() before upgrade state settles.
cap() supplies the upper bound compared against totalSupply() + amount inside the _mint override.
wrapped(extID) result reverts the wrap() flow when an external ID was already processed.
The _mint override triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer pause hook.
The burn path triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer pause hook.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' of wrap() is only meaningful together with the wrap entry point it belongs to.
Parameter 'amount' of wrap() directly feeds the mint unsafe operation and its cap comparison.
Parameter 'extID' of wrap() is scoped to the wrap uniqueness check on _extIDs.
Parameter 'extTo' of unwrap() exists only to be validated by _isPCIAddress.
Parameter 'amount' of unwrap() directly feeds the burn unsafe operation.
Parameter 'wrapper' is consumed only by __initialize when granting WRAPPER_ROLE.
Parameter 'addr' is consumed only by the _isPCIAddress validation routine.
Parameter 'newImplementation' becomes the delegatecall target of the upgrade unsafe operation.
Local 'addrBytes' lives only inside _isPCIAddress and should be folded into that function.
